decisions.observedsource: workspace_policy range bound + official demand queries

query.coverage_source: range upper bound; concrete checks are startup cross-checks

policy.coverage: Pinned FA2 scheduler-derived range bound over every admitted query/KV distribution
proof: The tile selector returns a member of {16,32,64,128}; all members are bounded.
For B requests and R rows, the sum of rounded-up packed query tiles is <= ceil(R*G/t)+B.
Default split search bounds split CTAs by floor(2*SM/KV_heads); CUDA graphs additionally pad to the query tile bound.
FP32 partial values and statistics follow the pinned allocator's 16-byte aligned order.
uniform_q_len restricts row distributions and is covered by the same all-distributions tile bound.

interpretation.relative_answer_result: All 16 paired QA texts and token sequences match; all four baseline-correct answers remain correct.
interpretation.absolute_answer_result: Default and auto each have four correct answers among sixteen outputs; these are repetitions of three tasks in four scenarios.
interpretation.performance_result: Two same-workload rounds save 6.25% and 5.38% batch time while earlier requests can complete later.
interpretation.next_step: Package supported configuration, explicit overrides, fallback and reproducible evidence into a reusable integration; retain shared task errors separately.
